Inference geography

For Claude 4.6 and later models, using inference_geo: "us" applies a 1.1x pricing multiplier. inference_geo: "global" (default) uses standard pricing. See Data residency for details.

Data residency pricing

For Claude 4.6 and later models, specifying US-only inference through the inference_geo parameter incurs a 1.1x multiplier on all token pricing categories, including input tokens, output tokens, cache writes, and cache reads.

Fast mode pricing

Fast mode provides significantly faster output for Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Opus 4.8 at premium pricing.
